status.quote: Workers AI allows you to run AI models in a serverless way, without having to worry about scaling, maintaining, or paying for unused infrastructure.

retention.value: not retained after the request is processed
retention.quote: For standard inference requests that do not invoke a stateful feature, Cloudflare does not retain inputs or outputs after they are no longer needed to process the request and deliver the response, subject to the limited exceptions below.
retention.note: The exceptions are storage the customer directs or a stateful feature needs (for example AI Gateway logging or caching, batch features) and content Cloudflare must analyze or retain for legal obligations; operational metadata is kept.

zdr.quote: Zero data retention: Workers AI processes Customer Content only for as long as needed to provide the service.

zdr_how.value: Nothing to turn on for standard inference requests; avoid stateful features that store content
zdr_how.quote: Our zero data retention commitment does not prevent storage that you direct or that is necessary to provide a stateful feature you select.

training.quote: No training: Cloudflare does not use Customer Content processed by Workers AI to train AI models.
training.note: The service-specific terms word it as: Unless otherwise agreed, Cloudflare does not use any Customer Content to train generative AI tools.

soc2.quote: Yes, Cloudflare has undertaken the AICPA SOC 2 Type II to attest to Security, Confidentiality, and Availability controls in place in accordance with the AICPA Trust Service Criteria.
soc2.note: The same page lists Workers AI among the Developer Platform services in scope for the report.

attestations.quote: Developer Platform: Browser Rendering, Cloudflare Images, Cloudflare for SaaS, D1, Durable Objects, Hyperdrive, Cloudflare Workers KV, Cloudflare Pages, R2, Stream, Vectorize, Workers, AI Gateway, Cloudflare Workers AI
attestations.note: The quote is from the C5:2020 in-scope list; Workers AI is also in the in-scope list for the HIPAA attestation at https://www.cloudflare.com/trust-hub/compliance-resources/hipaa/. Only the pages that name Workers AI are counted.

subprocessors.quote: Cloudflare uses the following third-party entities as sub-processors for the activities listed below:
subprocessors.note: CoreWeave (United States) and Nebius BV (England) are listed for Workers AI; Google and Oracle for the Developer Platform; Slack, Zendesk and Salesforce for customer support. Cloudflare Group subsidiaries are listed too.

regions.quote: Run machine learning models, powered by serverless GPUs, on Cloudflare's global network.
regions.note: No list of inference locations was found; the sub-processor list places CoreWeave in the United States and Nebius BV in England for Workers AI.
